verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents concrete official SDKs — a Payments React SDK for building agentic checkouts, a Credits Wallet Embed SDK for enterprise wallet funding, and a documented REST API (charge-token, introspect-token, wallet-balance) plus an MCP server for programmatic agent commerce workflows. However, SDK coverage appears narrow (React-only, wallet-embed gated to Enterprise customers) and a probe found no public OpenAPI/swagger spec, suggesting the broader multi-language SDK ecosystem an AI-native builder might expect is thin. Missing for 10: broader language SDKs (e.g., Python/Node core SDK), a public OpenAPI spec, and independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
